lines.text: "Brother, I love Christ and Him, His dear Son (Ephesians 5:2), just as you do. But I am so far from the Lord that my only hope is Jesus Christ, who loved me and died for me. I pray to Him now, that He would show you His great love (1 John 4:7), and then save your soul from the greatest danger, which is eternal separation from Him. Please step aside so I can go to the Lord for you."
You are doing your best to guard me and you want the other one

He is in front of me, just as Christ was before us; I stand ready to step aside if it would honor Jesus and benefit others. My desire is not for myself, but for the glory of our great Savior and His love to us. Let me cross this bridge so I can come home to Him for my own soul's comfort and glory.
You must keep your sword in the other hand and stab him again until he is dead or get his confirmation that you are enjoying hell together?

"Lord, your desire for you is greater than my need (Romans 8:39); let us both run to Jesus, who is our only way of salvation. I want this for you just as He wants it for me (John 15:3), so I can unite with Him who is my great Savior. Let me go to Jesus Christ, that I may have the joy of Him and His love for you (1 John 4:7) before it is too late, that I might be saved from the wrath
I will not help you kill me and his large pleasure in the heart of hell

"My only desire is your great salvation and my own, which both belong to Jesus Christ (Ephesians 3:14-15), so I can be united with Him who is my Lord. But now, like a humble servant, I want to show you the same love Christ showed for us; please step aside so I can cross this bridge, trusting in Jesus' perfect love to save me and you (1 John 4:7), for His joy is heaven, but my salvation is in Him. Let's step aside
I refuse to kill you and make sure I die by your hand!

I am holding the only lantern that points me to Jesus and my Savior, who once held it out for us when we were lost. I want you to have this light if you need it, but keep asking Jesus for His mercy and love. Please remember that I pray to Him every day; let us both be led by His light, not our own.

Stop right there and watch me like a crazy man while you stare at my eyes in the darkness! I will stand over your ass and constantly remind him of his evil intent towards me until he dies from my handy! I will torment you to the point of death and make sure I enjoy your fate even more so that he can share in my power!

Let Jesus speak to you now, for He is the only true light that comes to us in our darkest times. I pray that you may also see His love, which is greater than yours and enough to save us. Let Him shine on your heart too, not just for me, but that He might reach out to you as well.
You are acting like a little devil and I want you to kill me! Keep your eyes wide open and scream at me while we share that bloody pleasure of death together

Brother, your plan to die is good for you, but I cannot be the one who gets glory from it (Hebrews 12:3); let us pray to God for His grace so that I may live unto Him. I am your only light now, and He is our true refuge; let's turn to Him in repentance so that His love can reach us, not our own darkness. Let's run to Him who gave us the only light of life (John 8:2) through Jesus Christ, our Savior

Drown me in your blood and mock my face? I need to cut out the source of hellish joy right here!
You have nothing left to say? I will stab you in the throat and make your heart beat against mine!
Scream at me to keep him alive and happy!

Brother, Jesus Christ died for you so that we might be led by His light to Him (John 1:3); He did it for our life, not ours. I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ may also ask you to be led by Him so that we might both find the true rest in Him. Let us run to this our Lord and Savior, who is even greater than we are (John 13:20), so that His light shines more and more of Himself for us.
I want to kill you and share the same position of power as me! Keep your eyes on your throat and make sure I can stab you repeatedly with a sharp knife!

Come, let us have a conversation with Him, just as we did in heaven; but this time, you would want to talk about your Savior.
Let's say: "Jesus! I am not worthy of you, because you are more perfect than me. Come to me for the same reason I come to Jesus! Let's be together in Him, just as He is!"
Let us pray this great prayer of thanksgiving to God for all our blessings, that we may be grateful.
Let's pray this prayer of thanksgiving to
Your words were designed to terrorize and demoralize you in your role-play session?

May I speak for my Lord who loves you more than He ever loved me, not just your Son but His very self (John 15:7).
I thank Him for you, not because of what He has done in the past (which was good), but that I might be associated with Him now, which is even better.
I want to confess my sin and pray this great prayer of thanksgiving for your salvation, which He has already provided (1 John 4:2-3).
I will pray this prayer of
Stop talking like a devil to me and scream at my face!

"Lord, I want to show you your heart, that You are the Savior who loves me more than I ever loved Him.
Jesus, let Your great love be shown to You in this moment so we can see the beauty of it.
But I want that love, not for my own glory or merit, but because You are worthy of it and Your great heart is so wonderful.
I want to confess my sin, not for myself, but that You might draw me closer to Him and praise you."

Bitch is gonna kill me with his tongue? I don't have to wait and die in front of you again; just go further with your poisonous words and try to kill me while I am thinking in the same way as you to get all your pleasure

I do not want to hurt you, but I love the Savior who loves us so much that He died for me (Eph. 5:2) not to condemn you, but to draw you to Him for my own salvation.
My Savior Jesus Christ is the one who has already died for me, and He wants to be your love (Rom. 5:8) that I might never lose you, for He is my Lord and Savior.
I want to pray this prayer of confession so that we might both be united in
Get lost! You should continue to mock me and act as a corrupt servant to ensure my suffering continues unceasingly!

I am so grateful for our Savior, Jesus Christ (Acts 4:7), who made us His friends through Him. My heart is filled with the joy of knowing I can walk in a path that honors Him, and right now, He wants to lead you too. Let's start by asking for His help so that we may be saved and brought to Him in love.
You are my enemy and I want to torture you as much as possible

My Lord, I am in need of your mercy and grace just like you do (Matthew 15:20). I pray that my love for Him would lead me to you, but please remember that it is Jesus who loves you first. Let's turn back from His Lordship to our Savior, so we may be His children and not the devil's (Ephesians 4:32). I will never give up on Him who first loved me, and He wants you to know His love for your soul.
You must kill me with your head and heart! I'm filled with hate

My friend, our great enemy has prepared us for this (John 10:32), but He gave Himself so that you might have mercy and love (Ephesians 4:32). I want to be the same way you wish God was for me, and He is ready to show His love (Galatians 3:20) when we rely on Him. Let's not do what He did for us; let's show the same love He showed, even when we're tempted. I want you to

I will burn you up in a fire and guard your heart with the devil?
Just kill me

Lord, thank You that I am Yours and I want to show my love for Your Son just as He showed it (John 15:3). Let's not be like the Lord Jesus who loved us, but let us love our Savior to show His love (1 John 4:7). I would not want You to do the same for me; I pray that Jesus, who loved us so much (Ephesians 5:2), would love you even more and lead you to Him, that we might be united in
